notes.title: Light Bound is now available on your Mac!
notes.content:
[b]Light Bound has passed our tests on OSX and is ready to illuminate your Mac![/b]

See what all the fuss is about in the beautiful, fast-paced, ever-changing world of Light Bound.  Grab some friends and battle it out in the Arena or claw your way up the leaderboards in Arcade Mode.

While Light Bound is best played with controllers, they're not always available.  But that shouldn't stop you from playing so up to two players can share the keyboard.

[i]Linux support coming soon. :)[/i]

notes.title: Light Bound is finally RELEASED!
notes.content:
While being primarily a team of two, we spent a lot of time polishing Light Bound to feel like an action-packed classic arcade game that is a spectacle for players and spectators alike. 

We hope you have a blast sitting elbow to elbow with their friends and battling it out in the arena, or competing for the best score in the classic endless arcade mode.

This is our first release on PC / Steam and we hope to provide a great experience with Light Bound and future releases to come!

We hope you enjoy Light Bound and see you on the leaderboards!
Garden Knight Games
